purpose: Teach: 花屋/満腹/ひく/きのこ/けんか/人参/レタス/貰える

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、駅前の花屋、本気で、絶対、お母さんが、絶対、よく、本気で、行ってるよ、お前、知ってる?本気で、絶対、本気、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: Hey, Riku — you know how Mom is always going to that flower shop by the station?
lines.style: Bright, direct question. Leans forward slightly. Expecting him to know what she's talking about. Quick energy, like she's about to explain something she's figured out.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。給食、本気で、絶対、満腹に、絶対、なって、本気で、絶対、午後、絶対、眠くなるよな、桜、本気で、絶対、共感、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yeah. After eating lunch and getting that full feeling, you just end up half-asleep the whole afternoon, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Knowing, wry observation. Dry delivery on the setup. Glances at her like they share the same exhausting truth. Slight self-deprecating rhythm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 最近、本気で、絶対、風邪を、絶対、ひくこと、ないよう、絶対、お互いに、本気で、気をつけようね、リク、本気で、絶対、約束、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Lately, let's both be careful not to catch a cold, okay, Riku? That's a promise.
lines.style: Gentle but serious. Softens on the opening. Firms up on the request — not commanding, but sincere. The kind of careful that comes from actually worrying.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 家庭科で、本気で、絶対、きのこ料理、絶対、作ったぞ、桜、お前にも、本気で、絶対、食べてみてほしい
lines.en: I made a mushroom dish in home ec class, and I really want you to try it, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Soft opening on the memory. Builds slightly toward the 'want you to try' part — vulnerable but genuine. Not performing enthusiasm, just honest.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 弟、本気で、絶対、けんか、絶対、しないように、絶対、私、お姉ちゃんとして、本気で、見守ってるよ、リク
lines.en: I've been looking out for my little brother so he doesn't get into fights, you know? That's what an older sister does, Riku.
lines.style: Tender but matter-of-fact. Says it simply, like it's just what she does. Warm undercurrent — protective without being heavy. Slight lift at the end, checking he understands.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お弁当、本気で、絶対、人参、絶対、好きなんだぜ、桜、お前、知ってる?本気で、絶対、健康
lines.en: You really love carrots in your lunch box, don't you, Sakura? That's actually pretty healthy of you.
lines.style: Light tease wrapped in genuine observation. Soft praise on 'healthy.' Not mocking — actually noticing something small about her. The tone of someone who pays attention.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭で、本気で、絶対、レタスのサラダ、絶対、出店、絶対、するクラス、リク、お前、行く?本気で
lines.en: Our class is selling a lettuce salad stall at the cultural festival. Are you coming, Riku?
lines.style: Casual question with a hint of wanting to know if he'll be there. Bright but not forced. Open rhythm — genuinely asking, not assuming.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お父さんから、本気で、絶対、お小遣い、絶対、貰える時、絶対、嬉しいよな、桜
lines.en: There's something nice about the moment when Dad hands you your allowance, isn't there, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet, reflective. Slow pace — dwelling on the small pleasure of it. Warm, almost nostalgic. Not complaining, just noticing something genuine in an ordinary moment.
